statement: ∀ (a δ : ℝ) (U : ℕ → Set ℝ) (c : ℝ≥0∞), scaleCover δ unitI U → cost a U = c → content a δ unitI ≤ c
proof:
intro a δ U c hcov hc
have hb : content a δ unitI ≤ cost a U := by
  unfold content
  exact iInf_le_of_le U (iInf_le_of_le hcov le_rfl)
exact hb.trans_eq hc
